activities.title: Listen to Valentina's village memories. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Valentina: Every summer I visit my grandparents' village in the mountains. … Valentina: Grandpa wakes up at five to make bread. The whole house smells wonderful. … Sofia: What do you do all day? … Valentina: I help collect eggs — the hens know me now! … Valentina: In the afternoon we swim in the river, near the old bridge. … Sofia: And at night? … Valentina: Grandma tells stories on the balcony and we count the stars. … Valentina: Last summer I counted two hundred before I fell asleep!

outcomes.puede: Understand short dialogues with more vocabulary; identify main information in simple announcements.
Describe routines, favourites, community helpers; give short opinions.
Read short paragraphs; answer simple comprehension Qs; find specific info.
Write short paragraph about self/family/routine (40–70 words).
